clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, a Simple Sigil calls novice night elf warriors to training with Alyissia. It marks their first step into Teldrassil’s defense.

In Shadowglen, Conservator Ilthalaine guides young night elves as they seek their calling. A runner brings a Simple Sigil from the warrior trainer Alyissia, and Ilthalaine gives it to fledgling warriors. Its inscription tells each recruit to report for instruction. The token marks the start of their martial training as troubling times come to the World Tree.

Alyissia uses the sigil to speak with recruits about the kaldorei’s pressing needs. Teldrassil’s recent growth, corruption spreading among forest beasts, and the rediscovery of distant lands such as Feralas have stretched night elven protectors thin. The sigil holds no power. It welcomes a recruit among the guardians charged with shielding their people from emerging threats.
